question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is **"Amplefication."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Amplefication"** is not a correct spelling and does not exist in the English language. • The correct spelling of the word is **"Amplification."** • It means to make something larger or more powerful. (प्रवर्धन, विस्‍तारण, विस्‍तार) • **Example**: *That device needs an electrical **amplification**__.* • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1: "Theoretical"** means relating to or based on theory. (विचारों या कल्‍पनाओं और सिद्घांतों (न कि व्‍यावहारिक अनुभव) पर आधारित; सिद्घांत-प्रधान) • **Option 2: "Administration"** means the process of managing or organizing something. (किसी व्‍यवस्‍था, संगठन या व्‍यापार को नियंत्रित या संचालित करने की क्रिया; प्रबंधन) • **Option 4: "Interpretation"** means the action of explaining the meaning of something. (किसी बात की व्‍याख्‍या या बोधन, समझ) 38:Tc29, The correct answer is **"Reluctent."**
